title: Owner decisions of 2026-11-02: scan/observation activation and no summary sidecar

decisions.scan_observation: Approved: activate the prepared provider 32->33 contract change (tclean contract 33; fingerprint 20b8efdf4cbfc9f19fd3c0191a6a6dcba7111e91461603b67b2c826b0baeb9f9, as proposed). Implemented in 1b54421.
decisions.summary_sidecar: Declined: a tclean run writes only image products, as CASA's does. casars-imager writes <imagename>.summary.json only when CASA_RS_IMAGER_RUN_SUMMARY=1 (set by the benchmark scripts). Implemented in 64aed47.

scan_observation.route: public Python: casars.tasks.tclean(**kwargs) in a separate interpreter, CASARS_IMAGER_BIN naming the binary above, CASA_RS_IMAGER_RUN_SUMMARY unset
scan_observation.inputs: NAS casa-rs/tclean/20261031/scan-observation-engine-20261101.tar (SHA256 recorded in tclean-scan-observation-engine-20261101.json): input.ms (52,650 rows; four coincident fields, two observations, two scans each), CASA's oracle-science products and its three oracle-grammar receipts
scan_observation.limits: exact image-product inventory, masks and finite support; NRMS <= 1e-3, .sumwt within 5e-5 of CASA's peak; WCS, rest frequency, units, Stokes and frames; beam axes 1e-3, position angle 0.01 deg; exact iterdone/nmajordone/stopcode; maxpsfsidelobe and cyclethreshold 1e-6 relative plus 1e-8 absolute. Grammar: refused by casa-rs exactly when CASA refused, with no image written; CASA's product inventory otherwise
